capability: Complete the F07 committed-output recovery: every report-materialization failure, localized text, no success modal and a terminal progress state
searchEvidence: Pull request #448 review (P1): JsonException, FormatException and OverflowException, which ReportPresentationViewModel classifies as report-materialization failures, escape the committed-output fallback of CompositionRunPresentationViewModel after the BIN is committed.
Pull request #448 review (P1): the committed-output-without-report title and detail are English-only; ShellTextResources owns bilingual run text.
Pull request #448 review (P2): the fallback opens the ordinary Build Completed modal, and progress stays at 'preparing report' because only the normal path calls MarkReportReady.
semanticOwner: CompositionRunPresentationViewModel remains the only run-result projection owner; ReportPresentationViewModel keeps the only report-materialization exception classification; ShellTextResources owns the text; CompositionRunProgressViewModel owns delivery state.
terminalContract: After a Build output commits, a cancellation or any report-materialization failure classified by ReportPresentationViewModel publishes the committed output's path, size and SHA-256 without a report, in the selected shell language; the Build Completed success modal is not opened for that result; the progress projection reaches a terminal report-unavailable state instead of staying at report preparation. Behavior before the output commits, the normal success path, every output byte, name and range, and the loose-delivery handling are unchanged.
